diagram_previews.alt: Corner of a drawer: two thick perpendicular walls. A grey rectangular box leans across the corner; its edge joins a point 1.5 from the corner on the bottom wall to a point 2 from the corner on the left wall and is labelled 2.5. A red circle (the coin) touches both walls and the box edge, with a dashed radius labelled r.
